title: Claims Bulletin: Listing Quality Reviews and HostCover Property-Damage Settlements
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover).** The property condition share follows the outcome of the most recent quality review recorded on the listing the plan covers, because a listing whose guests have been reporting its condition carries damage that may in part be wear or damage present before the stay, which HostCover excludes: a most recent review ending in a suspension settles the property damage at 70 percent, one ending in a warning at 85 percent, and any other outcome, or no review, in full. For the property condition share, a quality review rates the guest reviews of the year before it, so the most recent review reflects the condition guests reported over the months around the stay. The percentage applies to the property loss being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

## The review that counts

The quality reviews (quality assessments) are recorded on the listing in Listings. Only the most recent one counts, whatever the outcome of earlier ones.

| Outcome of the most recent quality review on the listing | Property damage settled at |
|---|---|
| suspension | 70 percent |
| warning | 85 percent |
| pass | in full |
| not assessed | in full |
| no quality review recorded | in full |

## Cases (hypothetical listings)

- Reviews on the listing ended in a warning last year and a pass in the latest quarter: the most recent is a pass, so the property damage is settled in full.
- The latest review ended in a suspension after an earlier pass: settled at 70 percent.
- A property loss of 2000.00 being settled on a listing whose latest review ended in a warning enters the settlement at 1700.00.
